excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content:
Another item regarding the `ere` format that I was thinking of but not too sure about: 
With the addition of BALs I was wondering if we should add another optional element (and thus profile, `nobals`) to store these in the ere archive.

They are strictly not required in the archives in order to sync the chain from, but would increase syncing speed for those clients that use them for parallelization. It would be a bit similar as `TotalDifficulty` element in there currently, in the sense that it would only cover certain eras (gloas+), which makes it a bit more tricky/ugly.
